title: Approvals batch lock read answers "not locked" for a master-detail line of a locked master, unlike the single-record read it claims to equal
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYmRepQK9DkZeU7F53D

Filing gate: ① a contract defect with named locations · Source: fleet (out-of-scope finding F1 of the #36911 dev report 7138000944; filed by zone a4-U on seat repo:objectstack#4's authorization; this seat does not claim it — `domain:server` is outside its intake).

## What happens

The approvals service has two lock reads. The single-record read (`GET /api/v1/approvals/records/:object/:recordId/lock`, `IApprovalService.getRecordLock`) answers `locked: true` for a record held by a locking approval **and** for a master-detail line whose master is held. The batch read (`POST /api/v1/approvals/records/:object/locks`, `getRecordLocks`) answers only the first half: a line of a held master comes back `locked: false`, and the next write to that line is refused `RECORD_LOCKED`.

- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts:11330` — `getRecordLocks` asks `recordsHeldByLockingApproval` only.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts:11455` — the single read also asks `detailRowHeldByLockingApproval`.
- The contract text says they agree: `packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts:532`, "Each entry is exactly the single-record door's answer for that id", and the service doc calls `getRecordLocks` "`getRecordLock` for a page of rows" (`approval-service.ts:11305`).

reach: named real consumer — `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/hooks/useRowApprovalLocks.ts` reads the batch door for the list page's select-first cells. On a master-detail line object (showcase `showcase_expense_line` under a locked `showcase_expense_report`) it reads "not locked", the cell editor opens, and the save is refused `RECORD_LOCKED` by the detail-row lock hook. Measured at the service layer by the #36911 dev with a one-off probe in plugin-approvals' integration rig (`record-lock-read.integration.test.ts` copy, since deleted), at `origin/main` 8e4ac50d: `single={locked:true}`, `batch=[{locked:false}]`, `write=RECORD_LOCKED`. Not measured over HTTP; the route maps the service answer 1:1.

## Expected

The batch read answers each id exactly as the single read does, detail lines of a held master included — the contract text already says so.

## Acceptance

- `getRecordLocks` reports a master-detail line of a held master as locked, as `getRecordLock` does, without one read per row (the batch door exists to keep a list page to one request).
- A test pins single/batch parity for a record held itself, a line of a held master, and an unheld record.

Grading: area:workflow · Bug · Moderate (a list offers an edit the server then refuses; no data is written wrong) · reach named (grid cell lock read, showcase expense lines) · evidence measured at the service layer → p2. Triage confirms area, grade and routing.

Business reason: anyone editing lines of an expense report or order under approval in the list page is offered an editor that fails on save; the batch door was built so lists can warn first (#35795) and currently cannot for lines.

Dedupe: `getRecordLocks` → 3 hits (#36911 open, the consumer card that surfaced this; #35795 closed, the batch door's origin; #34366 a seat post); "batch lock detail" and "record locks master detail" → no card on this defect.
